Best Demo Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based skill to automatically create and export professional demo videos from your raw footage.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; AI processes editing tasks like trimming, adding titles, and exporting in 1–2 minutes.
- No video editing experience required—simply describe edits in plain language.
- Handles token management, session setup, and export workflow transparently.
- Designed for quick video turnaround, ideal for marketers needing polished demos without a dedicated editor.
